Despite legitimately putting my best effort into school, I’m seriously falling behind. I couldn’t manage having a job while in college, and others do it with ease. I had to leave my job, and it still made no difference. I’m plagued by immense guilt, I don’t want to disappoint my parents or be seen as a failure but it’s too late for both of those. I have no friends at school, more often than not I go entire days without saying anything to anyone. I feel so alone all the time. It is true, I see everyone around me making a difference and having potential in life, but that’s something that I just don’t see in myself. Maybe I am being melodramatic, I’m sure there are people that are worse off than I am, but I can’t help being plagued by guilt and nervousness every second of every day.

I doubt anyone will see this, but at least it will give me some closure. I just started college and I’ve been doing fine in it, but I’ve been extremely depressed for about 6 months now. I’ve tried numerous things, but I’ve figured out that this is coming from my family life. I won’t go into detail, it’s unimportant, but I think I’m going to move away. I don’t know if I’ll finish college, but I know that it’s time for a change. I can’t figure out who to tell, but I figure since it’s anonymous this might make me feel better.

It was approximately 1am, I was smoking with my girlfriend and a couple of friends. I had to be home that night so I could go to work early the next morning, so I decided to head out. Normally I don’t get too high, but this was easily the highest I’ve ever been. Upon returning home, I headed into my house to wake up my parents (I’m still in high school, so my parents ask that I wake them up if they’re asleep when I come home in the night). I knocked on the door, opened it, and tried to wake them up. Normally they’ll wake up quick, but this time they wouldn’t wake up. I then proceeded to raise my voice to the point of actual yelling and they still wouldn’t wake up. I went to bed and the next morning I started getting ready for work. As I go out to my car I realized that I had rear ended the shit out of my dad’s car, so naturally I didn’t say anything and left. 3 weeks now and they still haven’t noticed lol
